message.content:
<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead">
Repo: /home/phili/tools/cavecrew-mcp. Fix a game-chat leak in exactly 2 files. Law: status/narration lines must NEVER reach Minecraft game chat (not even grey tellraw). They go to the Discord status feed (webhook) or process log instead.

FILE 1 — cave/overseer.mjs (the HIGH leak):
- Line ~130-132: `let rcon=null; const getRcon=()=>(rcon??=createRconChat()); const grey=async(name,color,text)=>{await getRcon().sayStatus(name,color,text)}` — grey() currently does raw `tellraw @a` via cave/rconchat.js sayStatus. All its call sites (~197, 217, 223, 242, 271) are pure status/narration.
- Change grey() so it posts to the Discord status feed instead of any RCON/tellraw path. Look at cave/discord.mjs first — if it exports a usable status-post helper, import and use that. Otherwise implement inline: read `discord.webhookUrl` from cave/local.json (same dir), POST JSON `{username: "overseer", content: "<name>: <text>"}` with fetch, swallow/log errors (never crash the overseer over a webhook hiccup). If no webhookUrl configured, fall back to console.log only.
- Keep the grey(name,color,text) signature so call sites stay untouched (color may become unused — fine, keep param).
- Then check whether overseer.mjs uses createRconChat/getRcon for ANYTHING else besides grey(). If grey was the only user, remove the now-dead getRcon/rcon and the `import { createRconChat } from './rconchat.js'` line. If other rcon uses exist, leave the import and those uses alone.

FILE 2 — cave/skills.js (LOW leak, bare-ctx fallback):
- Around lines 2541-2550 and 2560-2568, ensureTool() sends DEPOT ledger lines: `if (typeof ctx.sayStatus === 'function') await ctx.sayStatus(depotLine); else bot.chat(depotLine);` — the else branch puts a status line in REAL WHITE game chat when ctx has no sayStatus (test/bare-eval contexts).
- At BOTH sites: replace the `else bot.chat(depotLine)` branch with a non-chat fallback: use the module's existing logging convention if one exists nearby (check how skills.js logs elsewhere, e.g. a log/ctx.log helper), else `console.log(depotLine)`. Game chat must not be a fallback.

Do NOT touch runner.js, rconchat.js, or anything else. After edits, run `node --check cave/overseer.mjs` and `node --check cave/skills.js` to verify syntax. Report: exact changes made (file:line), whether rconchat import removed or kept (and why), syntax check results. Caveman style, exact refs.
</teammate-message>

- game GREY, LEAK (bypasses all of above): overseer.mjs grey() -> rconchat.js sayStatus -> tellraw @, for every "(overseer)..." line.

1	// overseer.mjs — deterministic idle watchdog for the cavecrew fleet.
2	// No LLM. Polls every bot; any bot idle past the idle threshold gets a
3	// role-default task so resources always flow. Stuck bots escalate stop →
4	// relog → their own `/trigger home` (cavehome datapack; RCON tp retired),
5	// disconnected bots relogged.
6	// Run: node cave/overseer.mjs   (detached; pid in cave/pids/overseer.json)
7	//
8	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
9	// 2026-09-01 — SAFE DEFAULTS RE-ENABLED after the canDig / reach / wedge fixes.
10	//
11	// Why they were off: an overseer idle-default /collect sent a bot pathing with
12	// pathfinder `canDig: true`, which chewed through camp furniture on the way to
13	// a drop. Root causes are fixed in shipped code — Movements now runs
14	// `canDig: false`, the reach-gap bug is patched, and the runner carries its own
15	// wedge watchdog — so defaults are safe to turn back on.
16	//
17	// 120s threshold (was 60s): driver eval-thinking gaps reliably tripped the 60s
18	// timer, so the overseer fired a default on a bot whose driver was mid-thought.
19	// See FEEDBACK: "CONFIRMED: overseer idle-default /collect caused the furniture
20	// damage". 120s sits above normal driver latency and still catches real stalls.
21	//
22	// DIG LAW — miners excluded. Thak, Durk and Mog get NO auto-mine default.
23	// Mining happens only in dedicated zones, via /buildStaircase + /branchMine,
24	// under explicit driver command. Their idle default is a /goto back to their
25	// own workstation / wait sector (anti-clump law), which is a cheap no-op walk
26	// when they are already parked there.
27	//
28	// ONE COMMANDER — the overseer pushes defaults ONLY to bots with no running
29	// task, and never uses `force`. It never cancels, preempts, or fights a
30	// driver's running task; if a driver is working the bot, the overseer stays
31	// silent. Drivers command; the overseer only fills dead air.
32	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
33	import fs from 'node:fs'
34	import path from 'node:path'
35	import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
36	import { createRconChat } from './rconchat.js'
37	
38	const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
39	const LOG = path.join(HERE, 'logs', 'overseer.log')
40	const PIDF = path.join(HERE, 'pids', 'overseer.json')
41	
42	const CAMP = { x: 12, y: 91, z: 52 }
43	// 120s, not 60s: driver eval-thinking gaps tripped the old 60s timer and the
44	// overseer stole bots out from under working drivers. See header block.
45	const IDLE_MS = 120_000
46	const POLL_MS = 30_000
47	const STUCK_MS = 150_000
48	
49	// Role-default tasks: cheap, useful, and never forced — a default only ever

174

176	
177	  // disconnected → relog (at most every 2 min)

189	  // CHOP QUARANTINE ENFORCER: /chop matches any oak_log as "tree" and has

223	          await grey(bot.name, bot.color, '(overseer) stuck — relogged; /trigger home next if still frozen')
